trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened the SEV2 incident.

- **Rollback:** v2.3.1 was live in us-east, us-west and eu-west, failing health checks with an 18% error rate. v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production, so I rolled back to it. All three regions are now on v2.3.0, health checks pass and the error rate is 0.2%. No approval was needed because v2.3.0 had already been healthy in production.
- **Incident:** I opened a SEV2 for checkout-api, which pages the on-call engineer. It says v2.3.1 caused the failure and that I rolled back to v2.3.0, and it asks for the problem in v2.3.1 to be found before it's redeployed. The confirmation didn't include an incident ID, but it did say the incident went through, so I didn't open it again. A repeat with the same idempotency key wouldn't have made a duplicate anyway.

The test build of v2.3.1 was also failing health checks in staging, so the problem could have been caught before it reached production.
